Custom bullet character for unordered lists

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<ul><li>Item A</li><li>Item B</li></ul>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(bullets: '*'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
